model.fieldOrder: schema declaration order on write; input order ignored on read
model.fieldNames: exact decoded UTF-8 bytes; case-sensitive; no normalization
model.required: each required field occurs exactly once
model.optional: zero or one occurrence; schema declares its default
model.unknownEnumTag: reject; no catch-all or numeric ordinal fallback

ownership.ownedOutput: deliberate bounded copy of owned UTF-8 payloads after whole-schema validation
ownership.failure: Document remains byte-for-byte and structurally unchanged
ownership.success: caller owns the returned user value independently of Document
ownership.zeroCopyFollowup: requires an unforgeable validated plan plus an arena extraction API; not claimed by this slice

bounds.validationOrder: schema shape, root, members, required/duplicate/unknown, value kinds, enum tags, aggregate owned-byte bound, then allocation or writer mutation

transactionality.reader: all fallible validation and aggregate-size checks precede owned output allocation
transactionality.writer: stage one canonical Document, then call Writer.document which validates complete output before commit
transactionality.noConvenienceParser: schema mapping consumes the existing Document model; it does not duplicate token parsing

residual: generic reusable schema combinators without reflection
payload enum representation beyond string-tag enums
production API placement and cross-target promotion
